description: Use this to check whether Rightshold is operational before you depend on it, and to cite its record: the current component checks (ledger chain, sealing, anchoring, webhooks, storage), ledger and registry counts, plus the 90-day uptime record per component and incidents. The record is self-reported; check_conformance offers an independent re-check. No account or key needed.
name: get_status
title: Platform status and uptime record
